question: Can the release roots of the six Sniper Rifles and six DMRs supply absolute weapon/camera aim-sway baselines rather than only relative attachment factors shown by the Analyzer?

sourceFacts.fact: The known-answer control reproduced M39EMR WB selector -> WPM_Sway_IronSights_P05 selector -> WME_WSway_P05 Field_90fd0310 = 0.6666666865348816, matching site 0.6666667.

Each of the 12 WB roots has a cached direct Class_897c99a7 owner whose Field_9690d604[] contains the selected Class_2fea847d child and whose Field_819acc98[] contains selector ed425017-d1ed-4286-8bd1-90be0263f808. For each row, that selector GUID and Class_2fea847d.Field_90fd0310 were raw-checked. Parent/child indices and offsets are in l129-parent-path-details.json.

The root screen covered exactly the 12 WB and 12 GS crosswalk roots and matched their raw hashes to cached release Head 4892017 and the pinned descriptor SHA. GS decoded-object observations remain provisional.

inference: The WB records are selector-conditioned serialized weapon/camera sway multiplier operands. Selector ownership is direct in the cached root object body; it is not evidence of activation or field operation.
These roots do not establish an unconditional absolute aim-sway baseline or justify a site enhancement. L129 is exhausted within the inspected routes.
unresolved: No inspected WB/GS root route identified an unconditional absolute aim-sway baseline or a source-backed cross-weapon comparison of absolute baselines.
For each WB record, Field_90fd0310 is raw-verified, but these checks do not establish whether the operand multiplies, overrides, replaces a base-like conditional value, or activates at runtime.
The parent field Field_819acc98 contains two selector GUIDs on L115 and SV-98 while Field_9690d604 contains one direct child ref; ordering/activation is not inferred.
The GS root screen is a cached decoded-object screen. It found no decoded Class_2fea847d or Class_28d25398 root objects, but decoder-provisional screening is not proof of absence.
No external import sweep, broader one-hop target graph, Ability roots, or raw Ability route was inspected. Ability decoder rows are hotfix-only under the L115 route limit.
No amplitude, frequency, duration, native equation, runtime activation, or composition claim is made.
siteImpact: The pinned site iron-sight map has 0.6666667 for the six scoped DMR IDs and no entries for the six scoped Sniper Rifle IDs. The Analyzer composes available attachment sway factors in sim/applyAttachments.js and does not model camera sway. This remains site-display context: L94 prior work identifies iron-gated local WB sight-state entries and does not turn the selector-owned WB operands into unconditional aim-sway baselines. No site correction or proposal follows from this evidence.
